subject: Geografia
description_pt: Identificar e descrever problemas ambientais que ocorrem no entorno da escola e da residência (lixões, indústrias poluentes, destruição do patrimônio histórico etc.), propondo soluções (inclusive tecnológicas) para esses problemas.

components.description_pt: Identificar problemas ambientais ocorrendo próximo à escola e local de residência
components.description_en: Identify environmental problems occurring near the school and place of residence
components.cc_component_description: Identify ways environmental changes affect the types of plants and animals in a habitat

components.description_pt: Descrever causas e efeitos de problemas ambientais locais como lixões e poluição
components.description_en: Describe the causes and effects of local environmental problems such as open dumps and pollution
components.cc_component_description: Compare the environmental effects of human activities with efforts to mitigate those effects

components.description_pt: Propor soluções, incluindo tecnológicas, para resolver problemas ambientais locais identificados
components.description_en: Propose solutions, including technological ones, to address identified local environmental problems
components.cc_component_description: Use scientific evidence to propose a solution to a design problem in a given context

cc_matches.description: Make a claim about the merit of a solution to a problem caused when the environment changes and the types of plants and animals that live there may change.

Human activities in agriculture, industry, and everyday life have had major effects on the land, vegetation, streams, ocean, air, and even outer space. But individuals and communities are doing things to help protect Earth’s resources and environments.
Apply scientific ideas, principles, and/or evidence to provide an explanation of phenomena and solve design problems, taking into account possible unanticipated effects.
